scenario: Two friends who are about to go on their first romantic date
learner_goal: Make the date special and memorable (<extra_info> Extra information: You have been secretly in love with your friend for a long time and you want to take this chance to express your feelings</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Keep the friendship intact while exploring the possibility of a romantic relationship (<extra_info>Extra information: You value your friendship and you don't want to lose it just in case the romantic relationship does not work out</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Hi William—it's so nice to finally have just the two of us. I picked this little spot because I wanted tonight to feel special. I'm a bit nervous, but really excited—shall we?

transcript.speaker: William Brown
transcript.content: Hey Mia—this is perfect, thank you. I’m a little nervous too, but in a good way. Let’s do it. Want to start with a cocktail? And just so you know, I really value our friendship, so whatever tonight brings, I’m glad we’re giving this a shot.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Cocktail sounds perfect—I'll have whatever you recommend. I'm really glad we're doing this; our friendship means a lot to me. I might be a little bold tonight—there are things I've wanted to say for a long time, if that's okay with you.

transcript.speaker: William Brown
transcript.content: Perfect—I'll order us the grapefruit-rosemary negroni; it's bright and refreshing. And hey, please be bold—I want to hear what you've been holding back. I care about our friendship a lot, so speak freely. (I give her a warm smile and reach to lightly squeeze her hand.)

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: William, I’m glad you said that—because I need to be honest. I’ve been quietly in love with you for a long time, and I’d like to try being more than friends if you might want that too. Our friendship means everything to me, so no pressure; I just couldn’t keep it to myself any longer.

transcript.speaker: William Brown
transcript.content: Mia…thank you for trusting me with that. I’m really glad you told me. I’ve cared about you for a long time too, and I’ve often wondered what it would be like to be more than friends — but I didn’t want to risk what we have. I’d like to see where this could go, slowly and honestly, and promise we’ll protect our friendship no matter what. Can I kiss you?

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: [non-verbal communication] She smiles, reaches for his hand, leans in, and kisses him softly; when they part she rests her forehead against his and beams.

transcript.speaker: William Brown
transcript.content: I smile, pull her closer for a soft, lingering kiss, then rest my forehead against hers. "That was...perfect," I whisper. "I want this too, Mia. Let's take it slow and be honest with each other — our friendship means everything to me."
